test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the correct active form of the given sentence. "The damaged road will be repaired by the municipality."

options.text: The municipality will have begin repairing the damaged road.
The municipality will begining repairing the damaged road.
The municipality is begin repairing the damaged road.
The municipality will begin repairing the damaged road.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Active voice structure: The subject performs the action, and the object receives the action.
 
• The passive voice sentence provided is: "The damaged road will be repaired by the municipality."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "the municipality" at the beginning.
 
• The verb structure changes from "will be repaired" (future simple passive) to "will begin repairing" (future simple active).
 
• Ensure the object "the damaged road" remains in its place, receiving the action.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The municipality will begin repairing the damaged road."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The municipality will have begin repairing the damaged road." – Incorrect verb form ("will have begin" is grammatically incorrect).
 
• **Option 2: **"The municipality will begining repairing the damaged road." – Incorrect spelling ("begining" instead of "begin").
 
• **Option 3: **"The municipality is begin repairing the damaged road." – Incorrect tense ("is begin" is grammatically incorrect).

Note: This is a PYP question, and the official answer key has marked (correct option) as the correct answer, hence we cannot make any changes to it.
